maddeler.e:
تهاجرت (form VI)
# تَهَاجَرْتُ (tahājartu) /ta.haː.d͡ʒar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَهَاجَرَ (tahājara)
# تَهَاجَرْتَ (tahājarta) /ta.haː.d͡ʒar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَهَاجَرَ (tahājara)
# تَهَاجَرْتِ (tahājarti) /ta.haː.d͡ʒar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَهَاجَرَ (tahājara)
# تَهَاجَرَتْ (tahājarat) /ta.haː.d͡ʒa.rat/: third-pe
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
